_comment: Capability-root manifest for cell/ (founder ruling oyatie-0s8). This is the ADR-0562 capability's OWN service manifest, the `<root>/manifest.json` shape that ci/facade/service-tier-metadata treats as top-level. It exists because the capability-first rehome left 8 crates directly under cell/ that belonged to NO manifest: the sub-service manifests under cell/*/manifest.json cover their own services only. Every crate, service and SLO path below was read off the tree, not transcribed.
dr_tier_derivation: Strictest dr_tier declared by any absorbed service of this capability (cell-lifecycle=T1, cell-rebalancer=T1). The shared crates sit in the failure path of the strictest consumer, so the capability root may not claim a weaker DR class than the service that depends on it.

substrate_dag_position._note: ADR-0562 capability-registry declares cell tier=substrate stratum=S2; both absorbed services declare the same value.

purpose: Cell substrate capability root. The crates directly under cell/ are the capability-level cell placement, capacity, region and regional-pack model plus its port boundaries; they are libraries with no deployed runtime of their own. The deployed cell services (cell-lifecycle, cell-rebalancer) carry their own manifests, SLOs and contracts.

bounded_contexts.name: cell-core
bounded_contexts.description: Capability-level domain / usecase / kernel crates (pure, no I/O) under cell/core/. Covered by no service manifest before this file existed.

bounded_contexts.name: cell-ports
bounded_contexts.description: Capability-level port + API boundary crates under cell/ports/. Covered by no service manifest before this file existed.

contracts_non_claim: This capability root serves no endpoint of its own, so all three carrier arrays are EMPTY rather than populated: every OpenAPI, AsyncAPI and proto contract under cell/ belongs to one of the absorbed services listed above and is declared by that service's manifest. The internal_grpc block is present-and-empty, not omitted, because the H2/proto3 posture binds any internal gRPC this capability may later expose (ADR-0056/0105 zero-GraphQL, internal-only Protobuf); an omitted block would read as an unruled surface.

adrs.title: Closed Capability Registry And Deterministic Placement

sharding_automation.non_claim: A capability root of library crates has no tenant shards to split, merge or rebalance. Sharding automation is claimed by the absorbed services that actually run, in their own manifests; ADR-0348 automation is declared disabled here rather than omitted so the absence is a measured statement instead of a gap.

dr.non_claim: No runtime store, failover drill or DR evidence belongs to this capability root; DR is exercised by the absorbed services. `dr_tier` above is the inherited obligation, not a measured result.

foundation_non_claims: this manifest describes the 8 crates directly under cell/ and does NOT restate, aggregate or supersede the 2 absorbed service manifests listed above
no deployed process, served endpoint, measured benchmark, capacity telemetry or audit-chain writer is claimed for the capability root itself

slo_exemption.rationale: The cell/core and cell/ports crates are capability-level libraries with no deployed process, no served endpoint and therefore no measured runtime SLI; the two deployed cell services carry their own OpenSLO files at cell/observability/slos/. This root manifest exists to give those library crates a tier/DR/ownership accounting surface, and deliberately does not restate the sub-services' SLO coverage as its own.
slo_exemption.evidence: cell/observability/slos/ — the capability's OpenSLO files all sit under a per-service subdirectory there, none at capability level, which is the measured statement that no SLI belongs to the root crates
